sections.title: Situation, language and purpose
body: Goal: Understand the main message when everyday Finland-Swedish speech differs slightly from written standard Swedish.
Core vocabulary: uttalsvariant, sammanhang, huvudbudskap. Key phrases: Jag hinner int i dag. · Jag hinner inte i dag. · Vi ses utanför stationen.
Meaning first: use the language to complete a real listening variation purpose, not to display isolated grammar.
Purposeful return: Notice one variant in authentic speech, then record its neutral written equivalent.

assignment.title: Four-skill practice, transfer and delayed return
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: answer “Why is the speaker late?” from the recording before reading the script. Save the listening result separately.

READ: answer the gist and detail questions, and mark the exact phrase that proves each answer. Save the reading result separately.

SPEAK: Respond to a delayed-arrival message in clear standard Swedish. Record an independent first attempt, then improve one feature.

WRITE: Rewrite the informal voice message as a clear standard-Swedish text message. Draft without the model, then revise for reader, purpose, essential detail and next action.

TRANSFER: A different speaker uses a reduced form of är; identify the plan without transcribing every word.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: Notice one variant in authentic speech, then record its neutral written equivalent.
assignment.model:
SPEAKING MODEL: Okej, jag förstår. Jag väntar utanför stationen. Ring när du är framme, så hittar vi varandra.

WRITING MODEL: Hej! Jag blir lite sen eftersom bussen inte kom i tid. Den är troligen här om fem minuter. Vänta utanför stationen, så ringer jag när jag är framme.

takeaways: Use: Jag hinner int i dag.
Register: Jag hinner int i dag. → Jag hinner inte i dag.
Variation is listening knowledge, not a requirement to imitate a particular accent.
